title: Fenwick Tree 2D: Rectangle Sum Queries
statement:
Given an N×M grid initialized to zeros, process Q operations:
- "U r c v" — add v to cell (r, c)
- "Q r1 c1 r2 c2" — print the sum of all cells in the sub-rectangle from (r1,c1) to (r2,c2) inclusive

All coordinates are 1-indexed. Use a 2D Fenwick Tree (Binary Indexed Tree) for O(log N · log M) per operation.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N, M, and Q.
Each of the next Q lines starts with 'U' or 'Q' followed by the respective parameters.
outputFormat: One line per Q operation with the rectangle sum.
